{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928017971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928017971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍負圖者，非圖也，乃大⿔也。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928017971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其背上所有之紋，一長畫，二短畫，一白點近尾，九紫點近頸，四碧㸃在肩之左，二黑㸃在肩之右，六白㸃近足之右，八白㸃近足之左，三緑㸃近脇之左，七赤㸃在脇之右，五黃點在背之中，凡九所而七色焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928034355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羲皇","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928050739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以九位而定方，以一長畫、二短畫而生爻，以三才而設位，","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928050739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928050739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道由是而生矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928050739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛馬","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出書之初，有一白㸃、六黑點，在北近尾；七白點、二黑㸃在背近頭；","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三白㸃","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"、","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑㸃在背之左；","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九白㸃","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"、四黑㸃在背之右，五白㸃在背之中。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928083507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大撓","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928099891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定之，一六在下，合于北，生水，亥子属焉；二七在上，合于南，生火，巳午属焉；三八在左，合于東，生木，寅卯属焉；四九在右，合于西，生金，申酉属焉；五十在中，合于中，生土，辰戌丑未属焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928099891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四維也，斯地之氣也，重濁焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928116275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533867202815033359"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"𡊮天綱推六十甲子納音法","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928132659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄帝","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大撓","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"探五行之精，占斗罡所建，始作","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，乃定天幹十字属河之圖，一白生戊，二黑生乙癸，三緑生庚，四碧生辛，六白生壬甲，七赤生","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，八白生丙，九紫生己，而天幹成焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928149043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定地枝十二属","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928165427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928165427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之書，以天一生水，地六成之，合于北方，亥子属焉；天七生火，地二成之，合于南方，巳午属焉；天三生木，地八成之，合于東方，寅卯属焉；天九生金，地四成之，合于西方，申酉属焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928165427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天五生土，地十成之，合于中宫，辰成丑未属焉，而地枝定焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928181811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以天干地支綜而為","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六十","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子，而納音所属，則本於","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太元數","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：甲己子午九，","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未八，","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申七，","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉六，","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533867202815049743"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五，","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928198195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取奇數九七五而倍之生律，故律四十二；取偶數八六四而倍之生吕，故吕三十六。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928214579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"併律吕之數凡七十有八，黃鍾之數生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928230963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其為度也，皆本黄，而八音生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928247347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納音實参諸此。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928263731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一六生水，水本無音，遇土數五十則有音；二七為火，火本無音，遇水數一與六則有音。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928280115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖以土擊水，以水激火，相勝而成音故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928296499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三八為木，四九為金，如木遇木數，金遇金數，則兩木兩金相擊，自能成音。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928312883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五十為土，則取二七火數，盖火能陶土成器，而後有音也。","logicSentenceId":"7537948565928329267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533867202816540687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人戊癸本非殊，或加從革應相呼。","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722706478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四位土支逢一二，祿𫝗","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722722862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"權清出帝都。","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722722862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用真火生其土，有戊無癸，以子代之；有癸無戊，以已代之。","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722739246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子已","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722755630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃土成實之地。","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722755630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已酉丑","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722772014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福元旺水生焉，辰戌丑未四","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722772014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土若逢一二位，為成實之格，子已代戊癸。","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722772014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人有戊癸合","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722788398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子癸己，辰戌丑未，最貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722788398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲漢","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722804782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀氣。","logicSentenceId":"7538038832722804782","marginNoteIdL {"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王氏","logicSentenceId":"7537974461238558771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：","logicSentenceId":"7537974461238558771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑為大吉，乃金之墓，未為小吉，乃木之庫。","logicSentenceId":"7537974461238558771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以丑中金氣来尅未","logicSentenceId":"7537974461238575155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中水氣土尅下，曰治。","logicSentenceId":"7537974461238575155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木變化，仁義相濟，則反夀長年。","logicSentenceId":"7537974461238591539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或未人","logicSentenceId":"7537974461238607923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得丑，則尊辱卑榮，不為夀而為夭矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537974461238607923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天罡是辰，辰之中有水氣","logicSentenceId":"7537974461238624307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之所鍾也；天魁是戌，戌之中有火氣之所鍾也。","logicSentenceId":"7537974461238624307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰中之水尅戌","logicSentenceId":"7537974461238640691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873437468213263"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中之火，為精為神，水火既濟，則寄生續夀。","logicSentenceId":"7537974461238640691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或戌人得辰，則隂陽","logicSentenceId":"7537974461238657075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不正，為迈吟之破命矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537974461238657075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚","logicSentenceId":"7537980216518377499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：以上四節，並用真印，始得","logicSentenceId":"7537980216518377499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其詳。","logicSentenceId":"7537980216518377499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑","logicSentenceId":"7537980216518393883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金印，","logicSentenceId":"7537980216518393883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未","logicSentenceId":"7537980216518393883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木印，","logicSentenceId":"7537980216518393883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰","logicSentenceId":"7537980216518393883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水印，","logicSentenceId":"7537980216518393883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌","logicSentenceId":"7537980216518393883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火印，","logicSentenceId":"7537980216518393883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰","logicSentenceId":"7537980216518393883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土印。","logicSentenceId":"7537980216518393883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType {"lines":[{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683278898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"提要","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683278898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：一曰受氣，又曰絕，曰胞，以萬物在地中，未有其","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683278898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"象，如母腹空，未有物也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683278898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二曰受胎，天地氣交，氤氲而造物，其","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683295282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物在地中成形，始有其氣，如人受父母之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683295282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三曰成形，萬","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683311666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物在中成形，如人在母腹中成形也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683311666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四曰長生，萬物發生而","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683328050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向榮，如人始生而向長也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683328050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五曰沐浴，又曰敗，以萬物始生，形","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683344434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873437468966927"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"体桑脆，易為所損，如人生腹","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683344434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三日","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683344434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，以湯沐之，幾至困絕也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683344434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683360818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰冠帶，萬物漸荣秀，如人具衣冠也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683360818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七曰臨官，萬物既秀實，","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683377202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人之臨官也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683377202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八曰枉，萬物成熟，如人之興旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683393586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九曰衰，萬","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683409970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物形衰，如人之氣衰也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683409970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十曰病，萬物病，如人之病也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683426354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十一曰","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683442738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死，萬物死，如人之死也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683442738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水土生申，陰陽家之說","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683508274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也；土生於已，醫家之說也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683508274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖五行之中，惟土分休用，厚徳載","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683524658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物，居中不用者，土之体也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683524658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散在四維，各旺四季一十八日土。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683541042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873437468983311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683573810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"体生於己，乗父母之祿；用生於申，繼父母之位而生","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683590194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683590194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"李虚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推其形色，則水黑、火赤、木青、金白、土黃，此五行之正色也。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683606578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及其","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683622962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變易則不然。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683622962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常以生旺從正色，","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683639346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"常生旺，則正氣全，可見正色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶從母色，","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683639346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木之母也，死絶則黑；木者，火之母也，死絶則青；火者，土之母也，則死絶則赤；土者，金之母也，死絶則黃。夫五行死絕，則氣歸根見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"於母之地。凢人之遇苦楚而呻吟母者，乃其義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成形冠帶從妻色，","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683639346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"幼壮之年，及衰老之際，之即妻之時也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病敗從鬼色，","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683639346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"病敗之地，是鬼狂之鄉，受尅則氣歸鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683639346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓從子色。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683639346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𦔽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"為傳墓，為歛藏，故色在於子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其數則水一、火二，木三，金四、土五，旺生加倍，死絶减半。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683655730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以義","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683672114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推之。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683672114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"燭神經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行旺相囚休死例","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683688498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恬裕","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683688498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齋：","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683688498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873437468999695"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春木旺，火相金囚，水休土死；夏火旺，土相水囚，木休金死；","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683688498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋金旺，水相火囚，土休木死；冬水旺，木相土囚，金休火死。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683688498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論曰：五行當時者旺，所生者相，所尅者死，主我者休，尅我","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683704882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者囚。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683704882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨土無旺，金無相，水無死，火無休，木無囚，此其何故","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683721266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也？","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683721266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖一朞之日，三百六十，五行均旺七十二日，惟土為萬","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683737650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物母，各旺四季一十八曰。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683737650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃帝","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683754034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：土於長夏時土旺，金相","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683754034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水死，火休木囚可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683754034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683770418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：推命尤須詳此，則凶","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683770418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者或吉，吉者或凶。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683770418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛己","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683786802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得","logicSentenceId":"7538013459683786802","marginNoteIdList":null {"lines":[{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶宫中隨順生，更和天乙祿来并。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459850510362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生值此終富貴，無祿還","logicSentenceId":"7538013459850526746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須只貴名。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459850526746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盞恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7538013459850543130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873437469097999"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有人，","logicSentenceId":"7538013459850543130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午","logicSentenceId":"7538013459850543130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見","logicSentenceId":"7538013459850543130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯","logicSentenceId":"7538013459850543130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，丁壬交互，丁禄在午，積財後貴。","logicSentenceId":"7538013459850543130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫論五行之性，各致其用，水者其性智，火者其性禮，木者其性","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669574707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仁，金者其性義。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669574707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建者夫土則信而已，重厚寛博，無所不容。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669591091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以之","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669607475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，則水附之而行，以之木，則木托之而生。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669607475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金不得土則無自出，","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669623859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火不得土則無自歸，必損實以為通，致虚以為明也。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669623859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫論五行之用，多則太過，少則不及，其氣其數，有餘不足，皆能","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669640243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"致凶。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669640243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"抑揚歸中，然後為福。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669656627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功成者貴於退藏也，將來者貴於荣","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669673011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"振也。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669673011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功成者，謂五行禀旺者也。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669689395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺而能止息，是謂退藏。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669705779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將來者，五","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669722163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873438444847139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行在冠帶胎飬之地，其氣𧇊而未盈，故欲子母相生，以益其","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669722163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，則有榮進振發之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669722163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如木非其時則狷介，","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669738547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衰則為梗介，死絶則枯槁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"故為梗介。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金旺太過則動凶。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669738547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"炎炎者貴乎熄，不熄則有自焚之灾；","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669754931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滔滔者貴乎止，不止則有自溺之患。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669754931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫火行南陸而化𤍠，盛","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669771315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則焚烈而害物，至酉亥，則隂能翕之，然後温煖。","logicSentenceId":"7537948777669771315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水行北陸而","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590379017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化寒，盛則嚴冷而殺物，至夘已，則陽能闢之，然後滋生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590379017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言水火止熄則和也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590395401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂不得陽，則沉滔而不興；陽不得","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590411785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，則燥進而不復。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590411785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五行之性，大槩以胎生旺庫為四貴，死絶、病敗為四忌，餘為","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590428169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四平。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590428169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然有生而不生，旺而不旺者，此為凶，乃先吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590444553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有死而不","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590460937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海虞","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590460937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590460937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瞿氏","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590460937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藏本","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590460937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873438444863523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絕而不絶者，此為吉，乃先凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590460937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如水見戊申土，此生而不生也；水見見𢈏子土，此旺而不旺","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590477321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590477321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇此多成而反敗，因喜而反憂。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590493705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如水見","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590510089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590510089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夘金，此死而不","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590510089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死也；水見","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590510089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛已","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590510089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金，此絶而不絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590510089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行氣盡，而得父母之得，","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590526473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以生益之，則其氣復生矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590526473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇之者，危中有福，窮而通，屈而伸","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590542857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590542857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生𦔽太過，則福中藏禍；死絶太過，則福無可託。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590559241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫死絕逢子，","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590575625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殃變能逃。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590575625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金絕於寅，得甲寅水是也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590739465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金，有氣也，絶於水者，精也。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590755849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水至寅","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590772233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夘為精嗇之地，然精嗇則全，精全則神應氣化而形復於本","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590772233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590772233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水絶得木，䰟復天逰。","logicSentenceId":"7537950324590788617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之内，火雖畏水，火不得水，則又不能濟物；木雖畏金，非","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434766858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金則又不能成器。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434766858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火人得水者，在格曰未濟，言其終得濟也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434783242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木人得金者，在格曰斵輪，言其終得用也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434799626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火少水多者，火之","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434816010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢不及於水，乃畏其水也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434816010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金寡而木衆者，金之勢不及於木，","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434832394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃困於木也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434832394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金火全名鑄印，犯丑字即為損模；木金等謂斵輪，向秋生而為","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434848778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷斧。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434848778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金亦兩得，火亦兩得，在格謂之鑄印，惟惡見丑字，盖鑄印必","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434865162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藉土為模，辰、戌丑未皆土也，丑為破壊之字，得之者，乃𨮾印","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434865162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873438445125667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"損模，模既損，則火散金消，反致殃矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434865162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木亦兩得，金亦兩得，在","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434881546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格謂之斵輪，偏惡秋生，盖秋為肅殺之時，乃斵輪傷斧；斧既","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434881546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷，則木弱金闕，反致殃矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434881546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壺中子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火相濟，則精神具足；金木互用，則仁桑義剛。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434897930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水者，精也，火者，神也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434914314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二物相濟，故精神明靈而具足。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434930698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金剛而","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434947082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木弱，桑二物互用，則仁義剛桑而兩相得矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434947082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"燭神經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論其眷属，憂其死絕。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434963466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434979850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：生我者為父母，我生者為子孫，尅我者為官鬼，","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434979850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我尅者為妻財，比和者為兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434979850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慮在空亡之地，憂居休囚死","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434996234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絕之鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158434996234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873438445142051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命鈴云：生我者為祿，我生者為庫，我尅者為財，尅我者為","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435012618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435012618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如金以土為妻，水為庫，木為財，火為鬼，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435029002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"值病憂病，逢生得生，旺相崢嶸，休囚絶滅。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435045386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435061770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：值病憂病，以休囚絶滅為言；逢生得生，以旺相","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435061770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"崢嶸為義。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435061770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"值病憂病者，五行病中逢鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435078154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如木值","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己金，火","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"值","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，土遇","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木，金逢","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火，如此之類，旺相崢嶸。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435094538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435110922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢之氷嵗運，或值之鎡基。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435110922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看始終，隨宜消息。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435127306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父病推其子孫，妻灾課以夫年。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435143690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435160074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：五行相生為父子，隂陽相制為夫妻。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435160074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435176458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435176458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435176458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無疑，畏火急求以救之。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435176458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖金生水為子，水尅火故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435192842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如金","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435209226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873438445158435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾者，恐值火也，且看火之休旺如何。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435209226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖尅我者為夫，此乃救","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435225610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"解二法，最為詳要。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435225610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王氏","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435241994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：如丙寅火人見戊申土，火雖病","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435241994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而為戊申之父，雖病而戊申土長生，父丞子祿之䕃，雖病而","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435241994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不至於死也。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435241994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或丁卯火見甲午金為妻，金至午敗，可謂妻灾","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435258378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537953158435258378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡祿命、身三等官，各禀五行，率以其性推之。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440561190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以金為官，","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440577574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主職位清峻，多掌刑獄錢穀之任，决斷明敏。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440577574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇行年太歲在丑。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440593958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873440387711010"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為官庫主喜，亦取旺相休敗、有氣無氣言之，餘凖此。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440610342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以木為","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440626726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，主品秩清髙，和裕守慎。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440626726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇行年太𡻕在未為官庫，以火為官，","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440643110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主官序炎赫，為性猛烈，用刑惨酷，亦主發歇不常。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440643110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過行年太𡻕","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440659494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在戌為官庫，以水為官，主職畀位下，級陞序進，謙和得衆，矜恤","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440659494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤寡，亦有道性。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440659494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440675878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行年太嵗至辰為官庫，以土為官，主官序隱","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440692262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"審，難侵犯，厚重質直，法令分明。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440692262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇行年太嵗至辰為官庫。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440708646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡五","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440725030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行之官，各隨其性則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440725030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金主義，主綱，木主文，主仁，火主禮，主猛，","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440741414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水主智，主順，土主信、主重。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440741414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若各失其性，則主為官不久，禍咎生","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440757798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440757798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440774182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440774182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木命，人以土為祿官，木為命官，金為身官，盖取尅","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440774182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我者為官，餘命準此。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597440774182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有所損丁遇兩壬之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441019942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又須四貴華蓋上遇正官者，主大","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441036326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441036326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四平","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441036326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次之。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441036326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"並三命提要：","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441052710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真官時遇，早達金紫之封；日遇真官，貴則時加祿命。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441052710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時日生遇","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441069094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印，須慿有氣之鄉，若遇衝空亡，此等遇如不遇也。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441069094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印遇鬼，","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441085478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印如無，鬼旺鬼衰，詳其勝負。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441085478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官刑命喜，莫教命反刑官。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441101862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441118246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受刑，縱貴不戎，即吏官印明無暗有。","logicSentenceId":"7537984597441118246","marginNoteIdList":null," {"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今人行","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215900206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運多用約法，以一𡻕竒八月起運，便以三𡻕九月之大運也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215900206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海虞","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215916590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215916590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瞿氏","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215916590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藏本，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215916590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506173492"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今人行運多用約法，以一𡻕奇八月起運，便以三𡻕九月過矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215916590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不明折除實歷之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215932974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論行運至五行生旺之地，如木之","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215949358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得春，其𢾾榮華實可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215949358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或行運至五行休敗之地，如木之","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215965742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢秋，衰朽枯槁亦可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215965742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之五行四柱休旺，生死之理在。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215982126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乎悟理窮幽，達微通變，以盡其妙。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256215998510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其為氣也，將来者進，功成者退。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216014894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216031278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：將来者進，迎之以臨官帝狂，功成者退，背之以","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216031278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休廢死囚，則禍福吉凶可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216031278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或若生逢休敗，早𡻕孤貧；老遇建旺之鄉，臨年偃蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216047662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216064046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：身須逐運，必假運而資身；勢須及時，亦假時而","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216064046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二恬。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216064046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216080430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506189876"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成勢：生逢旺𡻕，運須處於旺鄉；晚遇衰年，運恰宜於困地。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216080430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"並","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216096814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琰子","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216096814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老幼慎勿坐強，壮實惟宜趍旺。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216096814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺雖吉而未必吉，衰滅雖凶而未必凶。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216113198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逹此者始可論運。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216129582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖人自生至老，必從微以至少壮。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216145966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十𡻕、二十𡻕方當少年之","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216162350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，惟可行胞胎飬生、沐浴鬼帶䖏；三十、四十崴當陽強齒壮","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216162350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之時，乃可行旺䖏；五十六十𡻕當天癸枯竭，只可行哀。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216162350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反此","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216178734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，如老得少年脉，少年得老脉，非所宜也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216178734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若值一生運背，三限驅馳，直饒晚入旺鄉，已非符叶。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216195118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人初中之限，合行生旺而不生枉，晚老之年，合行衰絶而","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216211502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506206260"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不衰絶，乃謂運背。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216211502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此等人三限最為驅馳運蹇也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216227886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"並","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216244270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216244270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年雖逢於冠帶，尚有餘灾；初入衰年，尤被尠福。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216244270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王氏","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216260654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：年運或初離沐浴暴敗之地，而順行纔至鬼帶之","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216260654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上，未可便以為福，盖尚有衰敗之餘災也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216260654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或自任地而行，初","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216277038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至衰鄉，亦不可便以為禍，盖尤被旺鄉之鄉福也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216277038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以行運","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216293422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有前後五行之說，盖由此耶。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216293422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將徹不徹，寕有久否之殃；欲交不交，尚有幾殘之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216309806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運在衰絶䖏，将入吉慶之地者，必於臨離之時，更有重撓；運","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216326190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在吉慶之地，将入衰絕之䖏，必於初入之時，更有重福也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216326190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壺子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂男陽女，時觀出入之年；隂女陽男，更看元辰之歲。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216342574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216358958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506222644"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王氏","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216358958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注云：男，陽也，或禀五行之隂而生，則謂之隂男；女，隂也，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216358958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或禀五行之陽而生，則謂之陽女。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216358958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂男陽女也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216375342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禀氣不順，故","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216391726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大運歴過去節，不順者，時觀出運入運之年，而有吉凶之變。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216391726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順者雖不以出入之年為應，亦不可與元辰之厄㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216408110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命指掌","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216424494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：凡陰男陽女至交運時，主有灾滯；陽隂男女","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216424494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大小運行年元辰，亦為厄難。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216424494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元辰犯運，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仲尼","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"困","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳蔡","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之饑；","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行年二運遇元辰，灾福併至，故譬夫子之厄","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳蔡","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216440878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壺中子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運至本命宫，五行生旺，支干和禄馬貴人、食神相生，有益","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216457262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠁅為吉泰之運，亦不能常為福。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216457262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須候太𡻕行年，又看五行生","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216473646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506239028"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，支干和合福神之地，方可發福。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216473646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大運至吉鄉，却遇逐年太","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216490030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡻕，小運到刑害之鄉，亦主細累浮灾，但不為重言也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216490030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216506414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至本命宫，五行死絶支千刑衝六害，一切云殺者，為屯蹇凶","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216506414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍之運，遇逐年太𡻕，又見刑衝，小運不和，死絶帶殺者，方可","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216506414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發福。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216506414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其小運與太崴到生𦔽祿馬、貴人一切吉神者，其年却","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216522798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主有小喜遂快事，但𡻕神過宫，復如故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216522798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運到臨官地事旺相之地，生人盛旺快樂，發權，進財生","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216555566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子，骨肉之慶，一運中亨通也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216555566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運到衰病之鄉，一運中多","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216571950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"退破財疾敗事。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216571950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運到死絕鄉，一運中骨肉死䘮，自身衰。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216588334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216604718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506255412"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍鈍悶，百事蹇塞也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216604718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運到五行敗鄉，主人落魄懶惰，酒","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216621102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色荒迷。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216621102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大運到胎庫成形冠帶之鄉，一運中百事得中，安康","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216637486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平易也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216637486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡推命之禍，須先度量基厚薄，然後定灾福。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216653870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運氣譬之船也，命","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216670254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬之水也，隨其水之廣狹深淺，發得船之力也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216670254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命有八分","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216686638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福神，行三四分惡運，多不覺其凶，福力厚後故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216686638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若五六分","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216703022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惡運，只浮灾細累而已，至七分惡運，方有重灾。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216703022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡五分福命，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216719406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行三四分惡運，為凶甚切；若四五分惡運，則須死，盖基地不","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216719406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牢故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216719406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命中五行衰者運宜盛，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216735790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寸珠尺璧云凡衰䖏行，運到枉䖏脫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行盛","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216735790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者運宜衰，衰者復行衰運，是謂不刃。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216735790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行不刃，則遁塞沉滯；","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216752174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506271796"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行盛而復行盛運，是謂太過，過則擊作成敗也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216752174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運行","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216768558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫，曾歷過本命長生𠁅者，謂之氣盛之運，雖歲運来衝","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216768558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅者，為禍不重，盖運氣強故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216768558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如大運未經長生，而歲運刑","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216784942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝尅破，則便為灾，盖氣未備，運弱故也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216784942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大運者，曾過旺相，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216801326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而逢死絕者，為灾輕。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216801326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖隂陽五行代謝之順道也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216817710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱死於此，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216834094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦須令疾而終。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216834094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若方經長生，歷於敗地，其中有刑尅惡殺，與","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216850478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命相符而見者，則五行之氣反戰，故為凶惡而終也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216850478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"並","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216866862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216866862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216866862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命有氣象，常取生，取時干神為氣。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216883246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲時、己時，則土氣也，","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216899630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216899630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金、丙辛水之類取之也。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216899630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行運至氣象得地䖏吉，不得地䖏","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216916014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216916014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛壬癸、乙庚丙辛為金水象，運至申酉丑上，得地𢈏辛","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216932398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五恬裕齋","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216932398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7533873444506288180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216932398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已、甲已、乙庚為金土象，運至申酉辰上，得地庚辛、丙丁、乙","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216932398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚、戊癸為金火象，運至","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216932398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已午","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216932398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌上，得地庚辛、甲乙、","logicSentenceId":"7537998256216932398","
